text_block_list.text:
As part of the recreational activities during summer training camp,
everyone made curry in groups, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Umm... well then, I'm counting on you both.
Teio, McQueen-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, leave it to me.
As an umamusume of the Mejiro family, I shall make the perfect curry.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then count me in too!
I'll make the ultimate curry that'll rival McQueen's!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I'm glad it's you two.
Now I can make curry without any worriesâª

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: McQueen-saaan, are you done washing the rice?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I have just finished
washing the 308th grain!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "I'm aiming for the perfect curry. So naturally, washing each grain of rice with utmost care is only to be expected, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No, no, McQueen. If you do that,
we'll never get to eat our curry.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I've already washed 1,000 grains, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? Urgh... To think that I,
of all people, would lose to Teio-san...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll wash the rice.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So Teio, McQueen-san,
could I ask you two to peel the potatoes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No way...!
To abandon a job halfway through...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No, I'm the one who wants to switch.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to ask someone who's good with their hands from the start.
Like... McQueen-san, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood.
Then I shall do that instead."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm quite confident in my dexterity, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*
Even after that, Daiwa Scarlet cooked up a storm while deftly maneuvering around every obstacle...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that was delicious!! Curry eaten on
the beach tastes ten times better than usual!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That curry was a delight to look at as well, wasn't it?
And the potatoes that I prepared...♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Finally, a moment to breathe... huh...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's true... But we managed to make
a delicious, perfect curry... so it's all good...

Just as she described,
the curry she made turned out to be magnificent.
choice_data_list: You're really good at cooking, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Well, yeah. There's nothing I can't do.
I can handle all the housework, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Mom and Dad were away from home a lot, so if there was something I couldn't do, it'd be trouble when I was alone, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Mom and the others would probably feel much more relieved
with Scarlet, who's brilliant and can do anything."
choice_data_list: You're a model student even at home, huh.
You're a model student even at home, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Scarlet!!
What should we do with the cleanup?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah... hang on a sec. I'm coming right now—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "...Really? That's a huge help."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're pretty dependable outside
of training too, aren't you?
choice_data_list: You can always count on me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. And you get carried away so easily.

And as I was washing the dishes
with Daiwa Scarlet and the othersâ

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...What did you just say?
Trainer-san?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No, no~, don't be like that!
Come on, please tell me~♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, if you're feeling shy,
shall we talk over at the edge of the beach?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Right?
...It seems my only option is to keep apologizing for a while.
As a result, in exchange for Daiwa Scarlet doing it, I ended up having to wash the dishes to be forgiven, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right!
Are you running in the Shuka Sho too, Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...? Of course.
I was planning on entering normally, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Is that so! Then you're just like Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Good luck to both of you!
I'm rooting for the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, is that so.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You heard the news too, right?
That Vodka's running in the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's a once-in-a-lifetime chance.
And there, I will...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's get fired up! We're the ones who are gonna be 'Number One'!!
"And so, the stage was set for a renewed rivalry with Vodka—"
